name: bengous-plugins

plugins.name: claude-orchestration
plugins.description: Parallel multi-agent orchestration for complex features with Task-based coordination and git-wt --stack worktree isolation

plugins.name: git
plugins.description: Local history without an editor: commit with an optional issue-closing trailer, interactive rebase, squash by pattern or hash

plugins.name: github-flow
plugins.description: GitHub lifecycle through gh: agent-ready issues, review-ready PRs that show the change in diagrams, images and video, issue and PR triage, CI-gated linear merge, commit-push-PR in one step, stacked PRs with gh stack, and an issue-to-PR loop whose worker agents land their own PR

plugins.name: repo-bootstrap
plugins.description: One-shot repo setup: the dev-trunk/main-release linear model, branches migrated to submodules with GitHub Actions sync

plugins.name: code-quality
plugins.description: Code quality and cleanup commands for maintaining clean, maintainable code

plugins.name: mermaid-diagrams
plugins.description: Create and edit Mermaid diagrams for software engineering work, architectural ideas, and technical documentation

plugins.name: claude-meta-tools
plugins.description: Meta tooling for Claude Code: write prompts that prompt better (meta-prompt) and aim them higher (ambition)

plugins.name: claude-settings-manager
plugins.description: Manage Claude Code settings with JSONC support and schema extraction

plugins.name: git-worktree
plugins.description: Git worktree helper with stack support for multi-agent orchestration

plugins.name: agents-bridge
plugins.description: Bridge to the OpenAI Codex CLI for cross-model collaboration

plugins.name: software-craft
plugins.description: Opinionated design skills for software excellence: CLI design, system architecture, and more. Skills that push Claude toward intentional, high-quality output instead of generic patterns.

plugins.name: understanding
plugins.description: Understand a topic, a bug, or a Claude Code workflow: minimal explanations, root-cause diagnosis, execution traces

plugins.name: design-studio
plugins.description: Generate 5 unique website redesigns using Theo's pattern: one agent, sequential creation, natural differentiation

plugins.name: plugin-cache-sync
plugins.description: Sync Claude Code plugin cache from local sources

plugins.name: git-sweep
plugins.description: Git branch and worktree cleanup that proves a branch is contained before deleting it and reports what it kept and why: an interactive sweep that asks first, and an unattended one that frees finished agent worktrees and archives abandoned agent branches under refs/archive/

plugins.name: goalify
plugins.description: Turn a rough task into the completion condition a /goal evaluator can judge: end state, proof command, constraints, blocker, turn cap. Draft-first by default, or interactive clause by clause.

plugins.name: context-management
plugins.description: Lifecycle of Claude Code instruction files: audit CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md/.claude/rules instruction budget, capture session learnings, and resync docs with codebase evolution

plugins.name: research-tools
plugins.description: Documentation research through optimal MCP sources and claim verification: research agents, source routing, web and codebase fact-checking

plugins.name: clean-comments
plugins.description: Audit and clean code comments: protects why/constraint comments, hunts comments that lie

plugins.name: architecture-audit
plugins.description: Architecture audit that grants the existing code no authority: derive the requirements, design the minimal from-scratch architecture, then classify every component KEEP / SIMPLIFY / REPLACE / DELETE

plugins.name: vellum
plugins.description: Plan at the frontiers and review the plan in the browser: decisions and interfaces before mechanics, vertical slices each closed by a check. /vellum:start opens a planning mode of its own: Claude writes the plan and its mockups and grills the reviewer on the open choices; the reviewer comments, edits or approves in a page, and the answer reaches Claude as a prompt.

plugins.name: todos
plugins.description: Shows the repository's TODOs in a scrolling band above the prompt, newest first: TODO.md items, TODO/FIXME/HACK code comments dated with git blame, and the findings agents record with todos-finding for a batch review; a Mine filter, issue links, picks put in the prompt for Claude, and a toast when one is added

plugins.name: secret-pane
plugins.description: Claude asks for a secret in a masked box and gets a placeholder: the value stays in the session's memory, becomes real only inside a Bash command, is hidden again in every Bash and Read result and in the prompt, and never reaches the transcript; the mod writes nothing to disk

plugins.name: agent-hooks
plugins.description: Quality hooks for Claude Code and Codex that a repository opts into with one config file: fixers run on the text before each write, and Stop lanes check only the files the session changed, with a green cache and a loop guard that lets a stuck turn end; in every repository, a landing guard on Bash refuses the one-way doors of a push, a merge or a release; where the profile asks, each agent commit names what triggered it and its session in trailers

plugins.name: pinpoint
plugins.description: Point at your running app and talk to Claude: the session's address serves the app with an overlay that picks an element by a click or a zone by a drag, takes a quick label or a note, and keeps each selection in a batch you send at once; the batch reaches the session as a prompt, each element described by its selector, role, accessible name, box and styles, each zone with an image of it

description: Personal Claude Code plugins: git workflows, code quality, agent orchestration, and plugin tooling
